policy: These gates are about whether a person can reach, build, hear and keep the block they want. They are deliberately not about whether the automatic window generator proposed it: P4.1.2-H4 recorded that must-show-catalog-recall is 14/16 and that record is not amended. A generator that misses a span is a shortfall; a user who cannot express the span they want is a dead end, and only the second one is what this contract closes.
supersedes: nothing. docs/phase4.1.2-h/00-catalog-hard-gates.json stays in force as written, including its recorded FAIL.

gates.description: Every region a user wants can be expressed as a range on the Full Timeline.
gates.failureScenario: The chords are on screen and there is no way to say which of them to keep.

gates.description: A range of any length becomes a candidate, with no length-specific branch in product code.
gates.note: Checked over lengths 1 to 64 from a fixed seed, not only over 19 and 22.

gates.description: Every chord event in the selected range is present in the draft.
Every draft opens in the editor with one slot per event.
Every draft can be auditioned, and what is played is what would be saved.
Every valid draft can be saved through the ordinary Vault path.
A saved manual block round-trips through the save schema unchanged.
gates.failureScenario: Edits look right on screen and vanish after a restart.

gates.description: A saved manual block is an ordinary member of idea.progressionBlocks, which is what Practice, Mix and the detail view read.
Creating or saving a draft changes neither the catalog's pattern count nor its reachability.
The recommendation list is byte-identical before and after a draft exists.
Manual rescue does not reach the detector.

gates.metric: same input, same range, same edits

gates.description: Every stage is a separate merge commit and no stage changes the product default.

qualityTargets.note: Measured, not required. A shortfall here is a reason to keep improving, not a reason to withhold a capability that removes a dead end.

notMeasurable.reason: Needs a real person at a real screen. Operation counts are recorded instead and are not a substitute.
